title: Claude Fable 5 is HERE (And It's Too Dangerous For You)
description:
Anthropic just released Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, but there is a massive catch. Fable 5 is so capable that it poses severe cybersecurity risks. To fix this, Anthropic routes dangerous prompts to Claude Opus 4.8. Watch the full breakdown to understand how Project Glasswing and safety classifiers are changing AI forever. Comment MYTHOS to get the direct access link!
